_about: Public-domain Robert S. Candlish (1806-1873, minister of St George's, Edinburgh, a leader of the 1843 Disruption, Principal of New College) for the Word Hoard: The Fatherhood of God (1865), The Atonement: its Reality, Completeness and Extent (1861), Life in a Risen Saviour (1858), Examination of Mr. Maurice's Theological Essays (1854), Reason and Revelation (1864) and Paul's Epistle to the Ephesians in a series of discourses (1875), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 11 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

candlish-fatherhood-1865: The Fatherhood of God: the first course of the Cunningham Lectures (Edinburgh: A. and C. Black, 1865)
candlish-atonement-1861: The Atonement: its Reality, Completeness, and Extent (London: T. Nelson, 1861)
candlish-risen-saviour-1858: Life in a Risen Saviour: discourses on the argument of the fifteenth chapter of First Corinthians (Philadelphia: Lindsay and Blakiston, 1858)
candlish-maurice-1854: Examination of Mr. Maurice's Theological Essays (London: James Nisbet, 1854)
candlish-ephesians-1875: Paul's Epistle to the Ephesians Expounded in a Series of Discourses (Edinburgh: A. and C. Black, catalogued 1875)

_excluded.candlish-memorials: Memorials of Robert Smith Candlish (1880) is William Wilson's book about him
